links.outcome: Department-guidance accuracy of LLMs with versus without retrieval augmentation from experience bank and medical knowledge base
links.effect: KEA, which adds retrieval-augmented experience, reflection banks and an external medical knowledge base, consistently and significantly boosted CCPG performance of all tested LLMs; best results still fall short of clinical expectations.
links.quote: Experiments show that KEA consistently and significantly boosts the CCPG performance of all tested LLMs on PG-Bench.

unlisted_practices: Reflection bank storing previously misclassified cases with corrections and self-summarized error analyses to iteratively improve LLM performance
Experience bank of validated successful cases for analogy-based reasoning

screen.reason: The study develops a dedicated benchmark for patient hospital department guidance dialogues and evaluates a retrieval-augmented grounding safeguard/framework (KEA) added across 25 existing LLMs to improve guidance accuracy.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation with experience and reflection banks
